questions.question: AWS Budgets can be used to:
questions.explanation: AWS Budgets lets you set budgets and receive alerts — including an alert when Reserved Instance utilization drops below a chosen threshold. It notifies you; it does not enforce hard resource limits or block spending, so it can't 'set resource limits to prevent overspending'.
